description: Removes the redundant so in sentence-initial because ... , so ... surfaces.
fp_risk_note: Low risk. V1 only removes the redundant so in sentence-initial because ... , so ... surfaces and leaves standalone because clauses or standalone so-result clauses unchanged.

positive.input: Because I was tired, so I went home.
positive.expectedCorrection: Because I was tired, I went home.
positive.notes: Sentence-initial because-clause with redundant so; so is removed.

positive.input: Because it was late, so we left.
positive.expectedCorrection: Because it was late, we left.
positive.notes: Same double-marker shape with a different clause.

positive.input: Because he was sick, so he stayed home.
positive.expectedCorrection: Because he was sick, he stayed home.
positive.notes: Causal clause + redundant so; rule keeps the because clause.

positive.input: Because I was hungry, so I ate dinner.
positive.expectedCorrection: Because I was hungry, I ate dinner.

negative.input: Because I was tired, I went home.
negative.expectedCorrection: Because I was tired, I went home.
negative.notes: Standalone because-clause with no redundant so must stay unchanged.

negative.input: I was tired, so I went home.
negative.expectedCorrection: I was tired, so I went home.
negative.notes: Standalone so-result clause must stay unchanged.

negative.input: Because I was tired, therefore I went home.
negative.expectedCorrection: Because I was tired, therefore I went home.
negative.notes: Different connector: therefore is outside the because/so doubling surface.

negative.input: I stayed home because I was tired.
negative.expectedCorrection: I stayed home because I was tired.
negative.notes: Mid-sentence because-clause without redundant so is not this rule.
